```{r echo=TRUE}
#Associazioni delle 7 Variabili in esame con Metagenomica by DEseq2
  ps_filt = merge_phyloseq(ps_filt, sample_data(sampleDt))
  sample_data(ps_filt)$groupIGA <- as.factor(sample_data(ps_filt)$groupIGA)
  sample_data(ps_filt)$pzID <- as.factor(sample_data(ps_filt)$pzID)


  ps.filt.DESeq = ps_filt
  otu_table(ps.filt.DESeq) = otu_table(ps.filt.DESeq) +1
  #print(ps.filt.DESeq)
  x = paste("~","pz +",  "groupIGA")
  my_formula = formula(x)
  #print(col)
  ps_filt.DEseq = phyloseq_to_deseq2(ps.filt.DESeq,  my_formula)
  ps_filt.DEseq= estimateSizeFactors(ps_filt.DEseq)
  ps_filt.DEseq= estimateDispersions(ps_filt.DEseq)
  diagdds = DESeq(ps_filt.DEseq, test="Wald", fitType="parametric" )

res <- results(diagdds,
               contrast = c("groupIGA", "2", "1"),  # log2FC(1) - log2FC(2)
               cooksCutoff = FALSE,
               pAdjustMethod = "fdr")
    
    
    
  sigtab = as(res, "data.frame")
  sigtab =cbind(as(sigtab, "data.frame"), tax_table(ps.filt.DESeq))
  sigtab = as.data.frame(sigtab)

  
#write.xlsx(sigtab, "../results/metagenomics/DEseq2/PrePostDiet/AnalisiComparativaMetagenomicaPrePostDieta.xlsx", sheetName = "1_vs_2")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

alpha <- 0.05

df <- as.data.frame(sigtab)
df$ASV     <- paste0(rownames(df))
df$Phylum  <- ifelse(is.na(df$Phylum) | df$Phylum == "", "Unassigned", df$Phylum)
df$Genus   <- ifelse(is.na(df$Genus)  | df$Genus  == "", NA, df$Genus)
df$padj_safe <- ifelse(is.na(df$padj) | df$padj <= 0, 1e-300, df$padj)

# etichetta: ASV + Genus (se presente) altrimenti ASV + Phylum
df$label <- ifelse(is.na(df$Genus),
                   paste0(df$ASV, "_", df$Phylum),
                   paste0(df$ASV, "_", df$Genus))

sig <- subset(df, padj_safe <= alpha)
ns  <- subset(df, padj_safe >  alpha)

p <- ggplot() +
  # non significativi
  geom_point(data = ns,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj_safe)),
             color = "grey80", alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  # significativi (colorati per Phylum)
  geom_point(data = sig,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj_safe), color = Phylum),
             alpha = 0.9, size = 3) +
  # etichette solo per i significativi
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = sig,
    aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj_safe), label = label, color = Phylum),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = 25, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot of differential taxa",
    x = "log2 fold change (Post vs Pre Diet)",
    y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    color = "Phylum"
  )
library(viridis)

# 1. crea la palette fissa in base a TUTTI i phyla del tuo progetto
all_phyla <- unique(df$Phylum)  # oppure da un dataset master
n_phyla <- length(all_phyla)

fixed_pal <- setNames(
  viridis(n_phyla, option = "viridis"),  # scegli l’opzione
  all_phyla
)

# 2. usa sempre questa palette nei plot
p + scale_color_manual(values = fixed_pal)



#p + scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis")
ggsave("../results/metagenomics/volcano_t1vs2.png", p, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 600)

```

Analsi peso soggetti dopo dieta
```{r}
# Analisi peso soggetti dopo dieta

# ===== SETUP =====
library(dplyr)

# ===== 1) COPIA DEL DATASET =====
sampleDt_copy <- sampleDt

# ===== 2) NOMI COLONNE UNIVOCI (risolve duplicati tipo "Fatty Liver Index ") =====
colnames(sampleDt_copy) <- make.unique(colnames(sampleDt_copy))

# ===== 3) CREA UNA VERSIONE NUMERICA DEL PESO (da "Weight pre") =====
sampleDt_copy <- sampleDt_copy %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    weight_num = as.character(`Weight pre`) |> trimws(),
    weight_num = gsub(",", ".", weight_num),
    weight_num = gsub("[^0-9.\\-]", "", weight_num),
    weight_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(weight_num))
  )

# ===== 4) MEDIA PESO PER GROUP IGA 1 E 2 =====
res_weight <- sampleDt_copy %>%
  dplyr::filter(`GROUP IGA` %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(`GROUP IGA`) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_weight = mean(weight_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(weight_num)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(res_weight)

# ===== 5) (OPZIONALE) SE mean_weight ESCE ANCORA NA, STAMPA I VALORI "PROBLEMATICI" =====
bad_vals <- sampleDt_copy %>%
  dplyr::filter(`GROUP IGA` %in% c(1, 2), is.na(weight_num)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(`Weight pre`) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 50)

print(bad_vals)

```
